parts.text:
On the surface, Breezie Media is the largest entertainment and communications network in the world. A polished multimedia empire that broadcasts news, produces shows, runs casinos, funds sporting events, and sponsors nearly every major public spectacle on the planet. 

But beneath the glamour and the spotlights, the truth is far less clean. 

Breezie Media is not just a company, it’s a system of influence. Reporters, producers, advertisers, and “consultants” move quietly across the world, gathering information, shaping perception, and deciding which stories are told  and which are buried. Every broadcast, every sponsorship, every “neutral” report is another move in a silent war for control of public opinion. 

The Network doesn’t need to fight on the battlefield. It owns the cameras that film it.

At its core sits Breezie the Hedgehog, the founder and CEO, a shrewd and charismatic figure who understands that power flows toward those who can tell the most convincing story. Some say she simply wants profit. Others believe she’s quietly building a world where everything, from politics to heroism, runs through her approval.

The Network’s operations reach far beyond news and entertainment. Off-the-record “partnerships” with corporate magnates, information brokering between rival factions, and discreet silencing of those who dig too deeply. Officially, the Breezie Media Network is neutral. Unofficially, it’s involved in everything. 

Its employees, whether camera operators, PR strategists, or high-level “consultants”, are part of an unseen machine that shapes how the world sees itself. Some genuinely believe they’re part of a force for progress. Others know better, but prefer a paycheck and protection over principles.

characters.name: Breezie the Hedgehog
characters.description: The owner and CEO of **Breezie Media Network**, Breezie the Hedgehog is a shrewd and ambitious businesswoman who built her influence through the media industry. Charming and calculating, she knows how to use her public image and business connections to further her own interests.

characters.name: Scratch
characters.description: A longtime minion of Eggman, now working under Breezie. Scratch is a loud, hot-headed and somewhat dim-witted chicken who often serves as muscle alongside his partner, Grounder. Despite his bluster, he is prone to bungling and frequently finds himself outsmarted by those he pursues.

characters.name: Grounder
characters.description: A longtime minion of Eggman, and now working under Breezie. Grounder is Scratch’s more practical but equally bumbling partner. A powerful drilling robot, his stubbornness and tendency to make mistakes frequently get him into trouble.

characters.name: Coconut
characters.description: A longtime Eggman minion, now working for Breezie. Coconuts is a hardworking but perpetually frustrated robot who often finds himself stuck with menial tasks.
